$comment: Global weather dynamics, PRD section 3. Zone wind state machine runs every checkEveryHours; storms follow Atlantic hurricane climatology (season Jun-Nov, peak Aug-Oct). Expected spawns: ~3.6 storms per season.

breeze.$comment: Land heats by day and cools by night: an onshore sea breeze peaks mid-afternoon and an offshore land breeze before dawn, fading out ~30 km from the coast. Historically the night land breeze is how ships worked east along a coast against the trades.

systems.$comment: Lows and highs drifting over the map (game-first, PRD section 3): a low's south side brings westerlies, the run east the trades deny. Tuned so the wind blows from the east about half the time across the open sea (packages/systems-weather/test/sailing.test.ts).

storms.$comment: The real main development region lies far east of the map; storms enter here already formed. Late-season (Oct-Nov) western-Caribbean genesis is not modelled. Forward speed 250-550 km/day is ~10-23 km/h; most Caribbean storms recurve near 25-30N.
